label: UK New State Pension
field.name: Name
field.entitlement: Weekly forecast or award before tax
field.confirmedDate: Confirmed State Pension date for earlier cohorts
field.deferral: Add the lifetime increase for eligible deferral
help.entitlement: Use your GOV.UK forecast or award in 2026/27 pounds. The full rate is £241.30 a week. Your National Insurance record may give a different amount.
help.birthDay: Leave blank to use the last day of your birth month. Enter the exact day if it affects your pension age.
help.confirmedDate: If born before 6 October 1954, enter the State Pension date from GOV.UK and use this pension only if that date is on or after 6 April 2016.
help.start: Payments can begin from State Pension age. An earlier selection moves to State Pension age.
help.deferral: Select for a qualifying delay with increased weekly payments and enter the amount before the modeled deferral increase.
invalid.person: Select an individual and check the birth month and day.
invalid.eligibility: Enter the confirmed New State Pension date for this birth cohort.
invalid.start: Choose a valid age, date or milestone for the claim.
invalid.duplicate: Use one New State Pension per person.
summary.scheduled: From the chosen start or State Pension age if later
